title: Light DEX: four local validators, six trading markets

configuration.affinity: One validator process and its threads per distinct physical core

methodology.throughput: Successful transactions per measured second, from node status.
methodology.latency: p95 from the driver's intended submission time to durable commit; joined by transaction digest.
methodology.correctness: After shutdown, every signed validator journal was replayed; certified history and equal-height state roots agreed.
methodology.limits: Two individual local runs, not an isolated before/after optimization experiment. Validators, generator and other services share one laptop. No confidence intervals or multi-host capacity claim.
methodology.security: Aggregate results only. Raw session artifacts include simulation signing keys and are not distributed.
